paraphrase: King Puṣpabhūti, a devout Māheśvara, hears of Bhairavācārya, a great Śaiva from the south famed for many kinds of knowledge and power, with thousands of disciples; he honours him and helps him in a night rite at the great cremation ground, which succeeds and brings the king a boon.
notes: Introduction checked in the DCS text; the details of the cremation-ground rite are from memory (low confidence).
